name: Runner Extras - Record.Get on a missing row
brief: Pins that Get/GetBySystemId raise when the row is missing and the return value is not consumed, and return false when it is.
description: AL decides Get's failure mode from whether the caller consumes the return value: `if Rec.Get(x) then` traps and yields false, while a bare `Rec.Get(x);` statement raises 'The <table> does not exist. Identification fields and values: ...'. The corpus covers only the first form. A runner that silently succeeds on the second hands the caller a blank or stale record and every downstream assertion then tests the wrong thing.
